chunks: Their backs do not rest on their beds, and they pray to their Lord in fear and hope, and spend of what We have given them (in charity).

key_terms.تَتَجَافَىٰ: do not rest / are elevated (referring to backs during night prayer)

ai.seo_question: What are the key characteristics of the righteous described in Surah As-Sajdah?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the Prophet Muhammad and Imam Ali (peace be upon them) as its primary addressees, illustrating the pinnacle of *Qiyam al-Layl* (night prayer) and voluntary charity (*Sadaqah*). It encapsulates the dialectic of *Khawf* (fear) and *Raja'* (hope) that drives spiritual ascension, emphasizing that true righteousness involves both intimate devotion and social generosity.
